ORDER BY d.Document_ID;

residualCases.publicQuestion: Find the number of cities in each district whose population is greater than the average population of cities?
responses:
SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS city_count
FROM city
WHERE Population > (SELECT AVG(Population) FROM city)
GROUP BY District;
